gaps.text: rawFrameDispatcher.invokeB503Outcome sends the payload its caller supplies; the files named for the inventory hold no family or selector constant. The five bodies are the payloads the dispatcher tests send and the bodies of the merged native diagnostic rows; the history index byte is optional and is not a constant of the named files.

writeSystemSingleRegister takes its group and register from a system configuration field specification held outside the named files; only the installer name and phone register pairs are named in them, so no other B524 write register is inventoried.

The named files bound the remote slot instance with the constant 0x0A for the regulator, thermostat and functional-module groups in the full pass and with startup scan limits that the named files do not define as a number; 0x0A is recorded as the upper bound.
circuit_calc_flow_temp is a constant of the register file, but readB524Float32LE rejects it before any send; it is inventoried so the constant has a row and is marked not sent.
